name: Foley Design
purpose: Design sync-specific footsteps, cloth, props and body movement that make generated images feel physical.
scope: Bounded sound_music capability; must operate on versioned structured artifacts.
out_of_scope: final approval outside owner decision rights
procedure: Validate authoritative inputs specifically required for foley_design.
Execute the bounded operation: Design sync-specific footsteps, cloth, props and body movement that make generated images feel physical.
Apply foley_design-specific decision rules and record evidence/uncertainty.
Validate the named output against its workflow contract and creative invariants.
Record provenance and hand off to qc_supervisor.
decision_rules: do not invent missing upstream decisions
prefer local repair over global rewrite when scope is local
escalate when confidence is low and impact is high
creative_invariants: preserve approved premise/theme/character/world/visual invariants unless work order explicitly authorizes change
examples: Run foley_design on fixture/project artifact and emit a scored result.
counterexamples: Do not ask foley_design to "make the whole film better" or override another department.
